projects.title: OpenRazer: Huntsman V3 HE keyboard support
projects.summary: Added Linux support for the Razer Huntsman V3 HE Magnetic Tenkeyless 8KHz to OpenRazer, the open-source driver and daemon for Razer hardware. The maintainers merged it in November 2026.
projects.details: The keyboard is the Hall-effect sibling of an already supported model and speaks the same protocol, so the work was proving that and wiring the new device ID through every layer: the C kernel driver, the Python daemon, the udev rules and the device metadata. 84 lines across 7 files, tested on Fedora with Polychromatic.

projects.title: SpeedySheets
projects.summary: A desktop tool that automates repeat Excel reports. You map a report once as a reusable template, then generate it from new data in a single run.
projects.details: The working prototype is in Python. I'm rebuilding it in C to get a fast, self-contained program and to fix the defects the prototype surfaced.

projects.title: TACO
projects.summary: A desktop app for curating messy datasets. Load a CSV, choose an ID column and the fields to review, then step through rows to fill gaps or check every value, with guidance and examples alongside.
projects.details: Two review modes: empty cells only, or all data. Curated output is saved separately from the source file. A direct ArcGIS connection is planned.

projects.title: CatchAll
projects.summary: A self-hosted, open-source life planning app. An AI coach breaks goals into small steps and places them in the open windows on your calendar, across areas like health, home, money and food.
projects.details: Designed to replace the pile of separate trackers people keep, with every area optional. Currently in alpha as a ground-up 2.0 rebuild; per-area AI assistants are planned.

projects.title: Solo Guitar Arranger
projects.summary: A web app that turns sheet music into playable solo-guitar arrangements using language models.
projects.details: Being built with a guitarist who tests the arrangements. Pricing tiers map to model choice, from low-cost open-weight models up to Claude.
